scope: one bounded closure review; six user-specified nearest-neighbor papers

sources.title: Smart Inverter Grid Probing for Learning Loads: Part I—Identifiability Analysis
sources.version: author accepted / TO APPEAR; 10 pages; arXiv 1806.08834v2
sources.read: Sections II-V: model, Remark 3, Definition 1, Theorems 1-4, Algorithms 1-2; appendix proof not line-by-line audited
sources.locations: PDF pp.3-4 known-network assumptions; pp.5-7 identifiability statements
sources.finding: Known connectivity, impedance, phase and regulator states; graph matching / max flow conditions for learning unmetered loads. EV inverter already mentioned.
sources.limit: Load observability for a known grid is not topology identification.

sources.title: Smart Inverter Grid Probing for Learning Loads: Part II—Probing Injection Design
sources.version: author accepted / TO APPEAR; 10 pages; arXiv 1806.08836v2
sources.read: Sections II-V, principal objective, constraints, estimator and simulations
sources.locations: PDF pp.2-3 equations 1-8; pp.3-4 equations 9-12; p.5 equations 14-17; p.7 simulations
sources.finding: Constrained design maximizes total pairwise state separation, with relaxation and randomized rounding, followed by noisy load estimation.
sources.limit: Not a D-opt objective. Sampling/rounding randomness is not stochastic user price response.

sources.title: Graph Algorithms for Topology Identification Using Power Grid Probing
sources.access: open author PDF and arXiv HTML
sources.read: Sections III-VI, propositions and related proofs
sources.locations: PDF pp.2-3 complete recovery and Algorithm 1; pp.3-4 Definition 1, Proposition 3, Algorithm 2; pp.4-5 equations 18-19
sources.finding: Full-leaf full-rank probing recovers full topology under stated sensing conditions; partial sensing recovers a reduced tree. Noise/amplitude/duration recovery analysis exists.
sources.limit: Probability analysis uses a CLT Gaussian approximation, noise information and positive r_min; reduced tree differs from a general Kron reduction.

sources.title: Inverter Probing for Power Distribution Network Topology Processing
sources.journal: IEEE Transactions on Control of Network Systems
sources.access: open author PDF and arXiv HTML
sources.locations: PDF pp.5-6 Proposition 1 and Theorem 1; pp.7-8 Section IV and Theorem 2; pp.11-12 proofs
sources.finding: Local level-set/depth restrictions; under known candidate lines and distinct known resistances, zero-loss candidate iff ancestor and level sets agree for probed nodes.
sources.limit: Theorem 2 conditions do not cover unknown arbitrary nonnegative line weights. Estimation/verification optimizations are not probabilistic price design.

sources.title: A Computationally Efficient Topology Identifiability Analysis of Distribution Systems
sources.access: existing authorized HKU browser session; stable public URL recorded, no session URL
sources.read: Sections 1-2.6 and 4; main branch-identifiability discussion, Algorithms 1-2 and measurement-placement scope; simulation headings inspected
sources.locations: Section 2 opening; 2.2 equations 1-9 and Algorithm 1; 2.3 equations 10-13 and Algorithm 2; 2.5-2.6
sources.finding: Per-branch identifiability from given connectivity and measurement locations, without readings, via branch-flow relation and incomplete Cholesky; placement of extra flow measurements.
sources.limit: Read equations' surrounding explanation; browser accessibility omitted some math glyphs, so no exact equation transcription or independent proof certification. This is not unknown-tree all-parameter completion or price response.

sources.title: Confidence-Aware Topology Identification in Low-Voltage Distribution Networks: A Multi-Source Fusion Method Based on Weakly Supervised Learning
sources.version: publisher full HTML accessed 2026-10-27; version-note history not independently audited
sources.access: open publisher HTML via parent browser; earlier web 429 resolved
sources.read: Sections 2.1-2.3, 3.1-3.2.4, 4.1-4.2, relevant Section 4.6 paragraph, Section 6; text search for coverage/guarantee across full HTML
sources.locations: Equations 13-20 posterior model; 21-30 fusion; 31-32 decision/confidence; Figure 7 explanation; real Case 2 error discussion
sources.finding: Confidence combines informativeness and consistency. Coverage in Figure 7 is the fraction of meters retained by score ranking. The single real-case error is high-confidence; dependence/calibration remain future work.
sources.limit: No topology confidence-set coverage guarantee established by reviewed method/results. Equation glyphs and Figure 7 pixels were not independently visually transcribed. Full HTML available, targeted sections read, not an exhaustive line-by-line review.
